hero.heading: Stories Worth Losing Yourself In
hero.body: Welcome to The Gilded Page — a curated bookstore for readers who believe a great book is the finest luxury. Browse thousands of titles across every genre, from gripping literary fiction to mind-expanding non-fiction.
hero.headline2: Millions of books, one click away
hero.subheadline: Discover bestsellers, classics, and rare finds all in one place.

featured-books-section.heading: Featured Reads This Season
featured-books-section.body: Hand-picked by our editors — these are the titles commanding attention in reading rooms and book clubs alike right now.

featured-books.title: The Midnight Library
featured-books.author: Matt Haig
featured-books.description: A dazzling novel about all the lives we could have lived, and the one that matters most.

featured-books.title: Demon Copperhead
featured-books.author: Barbara Kingsolver
featured-books.description: Pulitzer Prize winner — a searing reimagining of David Copperfield set in Appalachian America.

featured-books.title: Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow
featured-books.author: Gabrielle Zevin
featured-books.description: A sweeping love story about creativity, ambition, and the games we play with our lives.

featured-books.title: The Covenant of Water
featured-books.author: Abraham Verghese
featured-books.description: A multigenerational saga spanning 77 years across the lush landscape of South India.

featured-books.title: Intermezzo
featured-books.author: Sally Rooney
featured-books.description: Two brothers navigate grief, love, and estrangement in Rooney's most emotionally ambitious novel yet.

featured-books.title: James
featured-books.author: Percival Everett
featured-books.description: A radical, Pulitzer Prize-winning retelling of Huckleberry Finn told from Jim's perspective.

bestsellers-section.heading: Bestsellers — Flying Off the Shelves
bestsellers-section.body: Our most-loved titles, ranked by reader demand. These books have earned their place at the top — pick one up and find out why.

bestsellers.heading: Bestsellers
bestsellers.subheading: Discover the books everyone's reading right now.

cta-section.heading: Every Great Adventure Begins on Page One
cta-section.body: Over 2,000 titles across fiction, non-fiction, mystery, fantasy, and more — all at your fingertips. Free standard shipping on orders over $35. New arrivals every Tuesday.

ratings-reviews.label: Overall rating
ratings-reviews.description: 4.7 out of 5 stars across 2,841 verified reviews

ratings-reviews.label: Samantha R., avid reader from Portland
ratings-reviews.description: I read this in a single sitting. It's the kind of book that makes you call someone you love the moment you finish it. Absolutely life-changing.

ratings-reviews.label: James T., literature teacher from Edinburgh
ratings-reviews.description: I've recommended this to every student I teach. Haig has a rare gift for making philosophy feel like a warm hug. One of the finest novels of the decade.

ratings-reviews.label: Mei-Lin C., book club organiser from Toronto
ratings-reviews.description: Our entire book club was in tears by the final chapter. The writing is deceptively simple and profoundly moving. A masterpiece of quiet storytelling.
